yardstick.note: sigma_retrain = coef * 100*sqrt(p(1-p)). THE THREE COEFFICIENTS ARE NO LONGER STORED HERE. They are derived at import time by claims.py from reference.coefficient_band(), which computes them from the external cells in reference_sources.json. They used to be typed into this file, and because nothing cross-checked them they drifted from the cells: the typed minimum was 0.020 against a true 0.01941, and the typed maximum was 0.158 against a true 0.18566, because the two positive cells of forensic2609 had been missed when the list was assembled by hand. tests/test_claims.py asserts that no coefficient literal returns to this file.
yardstick.history: Earlier corrections, kept for the record. 2026-09-19: coef_min corrected 0.024 -> 0.020 because the minimum measured coefficient is smaller than the value then in use, which had made the audit harsher than the evidence supports. 2026-09-19, later: the whole block was removed in favour of derivation, after the typed values were found to disagree with the cells they claimed to summarise.

_derived_fields_note: Precomputed classification, sigma_star and yardstick fields were REMOVED 2026-09-19. They had already gone stale after the coef_min correction (one claim still read 'erased' when the corrected floor makes it 'inconclusive'). claims.py recomputes all of them from delta_pp, n_episodes, base_rate and the yardstick block, so storing them here duplicated a derivation that can silently drift. This file now holds only inputs and provenance.
